fidelity: F2a -- Physics-Lumped Reservoir Thermal Drawdown + Binary/ORC Power Cycle
source: Tester et al. (2006) The Future of Geothermal Energy, MIT/DOE; DiPippo (2015) Geothermal Power Plants 4th ed. Ch.16; Gringarten et al. (1975) J. Geophys. Res. 80(8); Armstead & Tester (1987) Heat Mining

unit.name: Generic EGS Doublet (Hot-Dry-Rock, fractured reservoir, binary/ORC surface plant)

T_geo_init_degC.note: Initial undisturbed rock temperature at depth (~3-5 km); EGS resource 150-350C (Tester 2006)

T_inject_degC.note: Cold-leg reinjection temperature returned from ORC condenser (Tester 2006 design basis)

m_dot_kg_s.note: Circulation mass flow through the stimulated fracture network (Tester 2006: 40-100 kg/s target)

k_rock_W_mK.note: Thermal conductivity of granite (Tester 2006 MIT EGS report)

cp_water_J_kgK.note: Specific heat of liquid water at reservoir conditions (IAPWS approx)

V_reservoir_m3.note: Stimulated rock volume contributing heat (Tester 2006: commercial EGS ~0.1-0.3 km3)

A_fracture_m2.note: Total heat-transfer surface of the engineered fracture network (Gringarten 1975 multi-fracture)

h_rock_fluid_W_m2K.note: Effective lumped rock-to-fluid heat-transfer coefficient incl. conduction skin (Gringarten 1975; Armstead & Tester 1987)

eta_utilization.note: 2nd-law (exergetic) utilization of the binary/ORC cycle vs Carnot (DiPippo 2015: 0.4-0.55 for binary)

pump_parasitic_frac.note: Circulation + feed pump parasitic as fraction of gross power (Tester 2006: 8-15% for EGS)

T_ambient_degC.note: Heat-sink (condenser) ambient temperature for cycle cold side

P_rated_kW.note: Nameplate gross capacity of the surface binary/ORC unit
